title: Efficient Test-Time Adaptation For Robot Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.20318v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement-learning policies for robot locomotion can fail at deployment when operating conditions shift (e.g., rough or slippery terrain, payload changes, sensing degradation), and retraining or manual recalibration is often infeasible under on-device latency and memory constraints. We study test-time adaptation (TTA) for robotic control: adapting a pretrained policy online and in a self-supervised manner during execution, without access to rewards. Our starting point is a lightweight baseline that updates only the actor using a frozen pretrained critic as a deployment-time performance surrogate. Building on this, we introduce TEMPO, a test-time entropy-regularized, memory-guided policy optimization method that stabilizes critic-driven updates under severe shift. TEMPO combines (i) an entropy-promoting regularizer on the critic's predictive distribution to mitigate overconfident extrapolation, and (ii) a score-based memory, inspire

translated_title: 面向机器人策略的高效测试时自适应
translated_abstract: 用于机器人运动的强化学习策略在部署时可能因运行条件变化而失效（例如崎岖或湿滑地形、载荷变化、传感性能退化），而在设备端延迟与内存限制下，重新训练或手动重新校准往往不可行。我们研究面向机器人控制的测试时自适应（TTA）：在执行过程中以在线、自监督的方式适配预训练策略，且无需访问奖励信号。我们的起点是一个轻量级基线方法，仅更新执行器（actor），并使用冻结的预训练评论家（critic）作为部署时的性能替代指标。在此基础上，我们提出了TEMPO——一种测试时熵正则化、记忆引导的策略优化方法，能够在严重分布偏移下稳定评论家驱动的更新。TEMPO结合了：(i) 对评论家预测分布施加的促进熵的正则化项，以缓解过度自信的外推；(ii) 基于分数的记忆机制……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TEMPO方法，通过熵正则化与基于分数的记忆机制，在无需奖励信号的条件下实现机器人运动策略在分布偏移环境下稳定的在线测试时自适应。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces TEMPO, a test-time entropy-regularized, memory-guided policy optimization method that enables stable online self-supervised adaptation of pretrained robot locomotion policies under severe distribution shift without access to rewards.
